name: com.innov8tif.okayid.cam.OkayCamDoc
description: OkayID Mobile (Innov8tif identity-document SDK) opens this camera screen for the document type requested by the app. It guides the user to photograph the configured document sides and sends the images for review.
disableEffect: The app cannot capture and receive the requested document images through OkayID Mobile if this screen is disabled.
